dashboard_conflict_investigation_2026_10.discrepancy_explanation: The 1835.300 MWh reading reported for Kukule PS on 2026-10-18 physically exceeds the absolute maximum 24-hour generation possible for a 70 MW station (70 MW * 24 h = 1680.0 MWh). The source inspection shows this test page (/test/test/index.php) lacked live production telemetry validation and likely reported cumulative/uncalibrated values. In accordance with physical engineering constraints, 1680.0 MWh is strictly enforced as the maximum daily ceiling, and the discrepancy is logged for scientific provenance.
